subject: math
description: Interpret box-and-whisker plots by comparing center, spread, shape, and possible outliers in context.
learningObjectives: Read the median, quartiles, minimum, and maximum from a box plot.
Compare medians to describe typical values in context.
Compare IQRs and ranges to describe middle spread and overall spread.
Use whiskers, median position, and possible outliers to describe distribution shape carefully.
Write evidence-based conclusions from one or two box plots.
prerequisites: Order numbers from least to greatest
Read number scales on statistical displays
Write a short conclusion using evidence
